stageA.sourceMathematics: Money story word problems: add face values to find current budget, then subtract item price to find remaining money; a negative remainder means cannot afford item.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Original warmup three separate eight-coin original pictures with values8 cents,40 cents,80 cents. Original price table: pencils75c, sharpener35c, eraser45c, pens18c. Lin and Diego source coin collections are IMAGE-ONLY, so budgets and remainders cannot be stated without actual picture.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Teacher checks real original monetary images and which price is applicable. First-party invented budget values not evidence of publisher coin count.
